title: 二瓦计法：由两表读数求负载参数
statement: 线电压 380 V、50 Hz 的对称三相电源（正序，U̇_A = (380/√3)∠0° V）经三根端线向对称星形负载 Z（未知）供电，没有中线。用二瓦计法测量功率：功率表 W1 的电流线圈串在 A 线、电压线圈接在 A、C 之间；W2 的电流线圈串在 B 线、电压线圈接在 B、C 之间（功率表图中未画出）。
测得 W1 = 7220 W，W2 = 0。已知负载为感性，求负载的功率因数、线电流，以及每相阻抗 Z = R + jX 的 R 和 X。

questions.ask: 负载功率因数 cos φ = ?

hints: 二瓦计法：两表读数之和就是三相总有功功率 P = W1 + W2。
对称负载时 W1 = U_l·I_l·cos(φ − 30°)、W2 = U_l·I_l·cos(φ + 30°)，由此 tan φ = √3(W1 − W2)/(W1 + W2)。
求出 φ 和 I_l 后，|Z| = U_p/I_p，再分解为 R = |Z|cos φ、X = |Z|sin φ。
solution: **2. 功率因数角。** W1 测的是 Re(U̇_AC·İ_A*)，以 U̇_A 为 0°，U̇_AC 的相位是 −30°，所以 W1 = U_l·I_l·cos(φ − 30°)；同理 W2 = U_l·I_l·cos(φ + 30°)。tan φ = √3(W1 − W2)/(W1 + W2) = √3 → φ = 60°，**cos φ = 0.5**。

en.title: Two-wattmeter method: load parameters from the readings
statement: A balanced three-phase source, 380 V line voltage at 50 Hz (positive sequence, U̇_A = (380/√3)∠0° V), feeds an unknown balanced wye load Z through three lines, with no neutral. The power is measured by the two-wattmeter method: wattmeter W1 has its current coil in line A and its voltage coil between A and C; W2 has its current coil in line B and its voltage coil between B and C (the wattmeters are not drawn).
The readings are W1 = 7220 W and W2 = 0. The load is known to be inductive. Find the load power factor, the line current, and R and X of the per-phase impedance Z = R + jX.

questions.explain: For a balanced load W1 = U_L·I_L·cos(φ − 30°) and W2 = U_L·I_L·cos(φ + 30°). W2 = 0 means φ + 30° = 90°, so φ = 60° and cos φ = 0.5. Or use tan φ = √3(W1 − W2)/(W1 + W2) = √3.
X = |Z|·sin φ = 10 × sin60° = 5√3 ≈ 8.660 Ω (positive, since the load is inductive).

hints: Two-wattmeter method: the sum of the two readings is the total three-phase real power, P = W1 + W2.
For a balanced load W1 = U_L·I_L·cos(φ − 30°) and W2 = U_L·I_L·cos(φ + 30°), which gives tan φ = √3(W1 − W2)/(W1 + W2).
With φ and I_L known, |Z| = U_p/I_p; then split it into R = |Z|cos φ and X = |Z|sin φ.
solution: **1. Total power.** P = W1 + W2 = 7220 W.

**2. Power-factor angle.** W1 measures Re(U̇_AC·İ_A*), and with U̇_A at 0° the phase of U̇_AC is −30°, so W1 = U_L·I_L·cos(φ − 30°); likewise W2 = U_L·I_L·cos(φ + 30°). tan φ = √3(W1 − W2)/(W1 + W2) = √3 → φ = 60°, **cos φ = 0.5**.

**Check:** W1 = 380 × 21.94 × cos30° = 7220 W, W2 = 380 × 21.94 × cos90° = 0. For φ > 60° the reading W2 becomes negative (the meter reverses); the total reactive power is Q = √3(W1 − W2) = 12505 var.
